overview.summary: Australia offers career-focused university and vocational study with strong student support services. Visa rules tightened in 2025–26, so a well-documented, genuine study plan matters more than ever.
overview.educationSystem: Universities offer bachelor’s (usually 3 years), master’s (1–2 years) and research degrees. Vocational education and training (VET) providers, including TAFE institutes, offer certificates and diplomas. Every course offered to international students must be registered on CRICOS.

process: Receive an offer and CoE from a CRICOS-registered provider.
Buy Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for your visa period.
Prepare financial, academic, English and Genuine Student evidence.
Lodge online in ImmiAccount and pay the visa application charge.
Complete biometrics and health examinations if requested.
Wait for a decision and check your visa conditions in VEVO.

financialEvidence.requirement: For the visa you must show enough money for travel, course fees and living costs. The living-cost figure widely published for a single main applicant is AUD 29,710 per year. Confirm the current amount and acceptable evidence in the Home Affairs Document Checklist Tool before you prepare funds.

insurance.requirement: Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for the whole visa period, unless an exemption applies.

conditions: Up to 48 hours per fortnight while your course is in session, including exam periods.
Unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks and after completing the course on your CoE while your visa is valid.
Master’s by research and doctoral students have no limit once the course has started.
You cannot start work before your course starts unless another visa allows it.

Jobs are not guaranteed and earnings depend on the city, hours, skills and the season. Part-time income should not be counted on to pay tuition. Check your rights with the Fair Work Ombudsman and never work beyond your visa conditions.

lifestyle.text: On-campus housing, purpose-built student accommodation, share houses and homestays. Book temporary accommodation before you arrive and never pay a bond before seeing a written lease.
Public transport is good in major cities. Student concession fares for international students differ by state.
Varies widely: tropical in the north, mild winters in Brisbane and Perth, cooler winters in Melbourne, Canberra and Hobart.
OSHC covers doctor visits and hospital care up to the policy limits. Dental and optical care are usually extra.
Australia is generally safe. Learn beach and sun safety, keep emergency number 000, and report workplace underpayment.
